craft_notes: Sthāyin: wind-vessel (the yoking image: yogin becomes the bowl at the clash). Rows: row 3 (rise→vessel). Close: vessel (bhājana — echoes v58's — the refrain of vessel). Rejected: 'junction' — killed: limit kept (pratyanta); 'witness' — killed: offering-vessel kept (the yogin as WHERE power receives).

lines: Two winds, clashing, inside or outside at limit:
yogin — of evenness-knowing's rise, the offering-vessel.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vāyudvayasya saṃghaṭṭād antar vā bahir antataḥ | yogī samatvavijñānasamudgamanabhājanam

reads_against.argmap: Where do the two winds meet? → The meeting-place is where evenness-knowing rises — the yogin is that vessel.
c1_essence: Two winds clashing: evenness-knowing rises, yogin vessel.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
